messages:
Maria (CS): FYI — ApertureTech's seat activity dropped ~60% this week. Procurement paused new seats. Looks like they started a parallel trial with NimbusAI.
Oleg (AM): ugh — any clue why? did they call it out in the last meeting?
Maria (CS): New procurement lead (Luis) replaced advocate last week. He flagged cost + integration effort; asked for a short bakeoff with Nimbus. Also reported failed onboarding webhook for one of their pipelines (see logs we pulled).
Jia (Solutions): Can you drop the webhook error? I can triage.
Maria (CS): Here — from support logs:
```
ERROR 2026-03-18 09:12:04 - webhook delivery 502 for /ingest/streams
Payload: { "customer_id": "apt-221" }
```
Sam (AE): Sam here — I pinged Luis earlier. He wants a clean performance comparison and a note on SLA/rollback. Offered a 2-week PoC but they want Nimbus to run side-by-side.
Oleg (AM): Plan: 1) Fix webhook asap (priority) 2) Offer an objective eval dataset and short-term dedicated capacity for the PoC 3) QBR with Luis + CTO to re-align. Agree?
Jia (Solutions): I'll own the webhook fix and quick integration test. ETA EOD today.
Maria (CS): I'll prepare the usage/runbook snapshot for the PoC and extract a 1-page cost + latency comparison to Nimbus. Any guidance on offering discounted capacity for short PoC?
Sam (AE): We can offer a 30% trial discount for dedicated seats for 30 days. Approving as a tactical win — will escalate to sales leadership.
ops-bot: :bell: Deploy pipeline CI passed for https://infra.redwood.dev/pipelines/apt-221
Oleg (AM): Nice. Maria — can you also capture the three evaluation metrics Luis asked for: 95p latency, median cost per 1k tokens, and error rate? Put them in the thread.
Maria (CS): On it. I'll post the snapshot and a suggested playbook by lunchtime. Thanks :thumbsup:
Sam (AE): I'll schedule the QBR for next Tue 10am PT with Luis + CTO + our Solutions lead. Jia, can you join?
Jia (Solutions): Yes, calendar invite pending. I'll bring a short demo to repro the webhook and show KV caching impact.
Maria (CS): TL;DR actions: webhook fix (Jia), PoC capacity offer + sales ok (Sam), evaluation snapshot (Maria), QBR invite (Sam/Oleg). I'll follow-up with a one-pager.
Oleg (AM): Thanks team. Keep notes in the ApertureTech renewal task (SFDC link: https://app.salesforce.com/015...)
Maria (CS): Added note and pinned the one-pager when ready. Closing interim alert — will re-open if seat activity keeps dropping.
